::: {#exr-palindrome}
#### Completing a palindrome

Let $\Sigma^*$ be the set of strings of the letters a and b,
including the empty string,
and write $s t$ for string $s$ followed by string $t$.
A palindrome is a string that reads the same forwards and backwards,
such as abba.
Consider
$$
\forall s \in \Sigma^*,\ \exists t \in \Sigma^*,\ s t \text{ is a palindrome}.
$$

1. Write its negation without putting $\neg$ in front of a quantifier.
2. Which of the two is true?

:::
